PSLT.description: Pressure Load Type (PSLT). Defines a named pressure-load type bound to an element geometry (ELEM_TYPE) plus a list of per-load-case pressure entries (PRESSURE_LOAD_ITEMS), each with a load distribution type and up to four pressure magnitudes.

DESC.description: Description of the pressure load type.

ELEM_TYPE.description: Element geometry the pressure load applies to. Case-insensitive; value must be one of the listed wire strings.

PRESSURE_LOAD_ITEMS.description: List of pressure load entries, one per static load case. The handler accepts at most 8 entries (size must be < 9).

LOADCASENAME.description: Static load case name (must match an existing STLD load case); resolved to its load-case key.

LOADTYPE.description: Pressure distribution type. Case-insensitive. Uniform: single magnitude in LOAD_P1. Linear: four corner/end magnitudes in LOAD_P1..LOAD_P4.

LOAD_P1.description: Pressure magnitude P1. For Uniform, the single applied pressure; for Linear, the first node/end value.

LOAD_P2.description: Pressure magnitude P2 (Linear only; second value). Ignored for Uniform.

LOAD_P3.description: Pressure magnitude P3 (Linear only; third value). Ignored for Uniform.

LOAD_P4.description: Pressure magnitude P4 (Linear only; fourth value). Ignored for Uniform.
